# Project Guidance

This project is a Vue 3 and Vite application written in JavaScript. Follow the existing single-file component patterns and keep inventory state in `src/data/ordinateurStore.js`.

## Setup Checklist

- [x] Clarify requirements: computer inventory with local persistence.
- [x] Scaffold the project in `Desktop/vuejs-project`.
- [x] Configure Vue Router for list, add, and edit routes.
- [x] Add five example computers and localStorage persistence.
- [x] Implement the reusable card, inventory list, and shared add/edit form.
- [x] Add search, total count, memory sorting, and delete confirmation.
- [x] Verify production build and browser CRUD workflows.
- [x] Update this guidance and `README.md` with current project information.

## Commands

- `npm run dev`: start the Vite development server.
- `npm run build`: create the production build.
- `npm run preview`: preview the production build locally.
